messages.subject: Question about the entropy statistic
parts:
Hello,

I had a quick question on the entropy fit statistic. I fit a 2, 3, and 4 profile LPA to a data set with 65,000 individuals. There are 7 indicators that the individuals are measured on. When examining entropy for these three models, all three have values that equal exactly 1. While I know closer to 1 is a good result, I find it strange they all equal 1.

Is there a reason behind this ceiling effect? A perfect entropy result on all models makes me think there is something problematic. Thanks!  

Best,
M

messages.author: 3cfaef29dbc536f8
messages.subject: Re: Question about the entropy statistic
parts:
Hi, thank you for your question - and I'm sorry for the delay. We have made a change to how entropy is calculated in the most recent version. If you are still curious about this, consider installing the (most recent) development version via the following commands:

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("data-edu/tidyLPA")

There are a few differences to the interface to be aware of, too (can check the README here: https://data-edu.github.io/tidyLPA/).

Thank you for your patience with this.
Josh
